title: Minuta 2025-08-07
summary: The minutes of the 7 August meeting (25bp cut to 7.75%, 4-1 with Heath dissenting for a hold) read more hawkish than the communique: behind the unchanged 'valorará recortes adicionales' guidance, only two members clearly argue for continuing the cycle, framing the smaller step as a way to signal continuity, while two members who voted for the cut set limits, one warning that the absolute stance is close to the neutral range so adjustments must be more gradual and another noting the differential with the Fed is near post-2008 lows and that the next decision is not predetermined. Heath argues there is no room to cut until core resumes its decline, wants the rate kept far from neutrality and asks for cautious, fully data-dependent guidance. Versus the June minutes, the Board has moved from executing large calibration cuts to debating how much room is left, with core persistence (third consecutive upward revision to the core forecast, merchandise inflation at 4.02%, analysts' expectations above target) the main brake. Dovish pillars still carry the majority: deepening slack, a cooling labor market with moderating wages, a resilient peso and loose global conditions under a weak dollar.

key_quotes.quote: la mayor gradualidad en el ritmo de los recortes permitiría señalizar la continuidad en el ciclo.
key_quotes.context: Dovish member: smaller cuts as a signal that the cycle continues

key_quotes.quote: la posición absoluta está cerca del intervalo de neutralidad, por lo que los ajustes deben ser más graduales
key_quotes.context: A member who voted for the cut warns room is shrinking

key_quotes.quote: Destacó que debe comunicarse que la siguiente decisión de política monetaria no está predefinida
key_quotes.context: Another majority member resists pre-committing to the next cut, citing the narrow Fed differential

key_quotes.quote: Por ello, consideró que por el momento no hay espacio para reducir la tasa objetivo.
key_quotes.context: Dissenting member: core not falling, expectations deteriorated, no room to cut
